meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查发布前的代码改动,提前发现遗留问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你发布npm包前想要多智能体全面审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 它先跑 /get-unpublished-changes 找出上次 npm 发布后的改动，再并行派最多 10 个 ultrabrain 逐项分析、1 个 /review-work 整体审查、1 个 oracle 汇总，产出风险判定和版本号建议。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求做发布前审查（如 “pre-publish review”“release review” 等）时才会触发；普通发布请求不会触发，/publish 直接发布。

say.text: 对这次改动做一次 pre-publish review
say.note: 先检测未发布改动，再并行派出审查 agent。

say.text: 发布前审一下，现在能安全发布吗？
say.note: 同样只在你明确要求审查时才会跑。

say.text: 审一下 v1.5.0 到 HEAD 的改动，并给版本号建议

howto.what_en: Runs /get-unpublished-changes to find all changes since the last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for per-change analysis plus /review-work and one oracle, then reports risk verdicts and version bump advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review (e.g. 'pre-publish review', 'release review'). A plain publish/release request does not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review on my current changes.
say_en.note: Detects unpublished changes, then fans out review agents.

say_en.text: Is it safe to publish? Review before release.
say_en.note: Same gate; you still ask for the review explicitly.

say_en.text: Review v1.5.0..HEAD and recommend the version bump.
say_en.note: Oracle layer adds version bump and changelog draft.
